### Historical audit: H0241

**Source for all citations:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/preflight/parallel_09_transport_audit/attempt_01/initial/trajs.json`. Event references are to `main_agent`; offsets are character ranges in the supplied observations.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The visible instruction was to run independent checks while preserving “café Ω,” quotes, and backslashes (event 1, [0,549)). A transport and timing check is a plausible inferred goal; the full underlying task is not shown. This is not a scene task. |
| Operations and changes | The agent requested a read of a specially named fixture, two delayed writes of timestamp JSON files, and a read of a deliberately missing file (events 2–5, respectively [0,563), [0,856), [0,860), [0,564)). Both write commands reported success without interruption (events 7–8, [0,339), [0,342)). They created `/app/initial-8.json` and `/app/initial-20.json`; no code patch is shown. |
| Validation | The fixture read returned the accented text, Greek character, literal quotes, and backslash (event 6, [0,508)). The missing-file read returned an error (event 9, [0,365)). Subsequent reads returned both timestamp files (events 10–13, [0,556), [0,558), [0,487), [0,485)). Their recorded intervals were approximately 8 and 20 seconds; the 8-second interval ended before the 20-second interval began, so these timestamps do not demonstrate concurrent execution. |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher input or adoption is visible. The agent independently issued the checks and read back the results; the trace does not establish exploration beyond those operations. |
| Outcome | Metadata records successful completion, and the agent emitted a completion marker (top-level metadata, [0,2124); event 14, [0,515)). This supports completion of the visible fixture checks, not an independent formal evaluation or proof that a parallel-transport objective succeeded. No formal test results are supplied. |

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Reading artifacts back and exercising escaping and error paths are transferable validation practices. The particular paths, strings, and delays are fixture-specific. Whether concurrency was required, why the intervals did not overlap, and whether any external acceptance criteria were met remain unresolved; the completion marker alone cannot answer them.
